api: xml_init(&ctx); ctx.h_warn = ctx.h_error = ctx.h_fatal = (failure recorder); ctx.flags |= XML_ALLOC_ALL; xml_ns_enable(&ctx); fbbuf_init_read(fastbuf, copy of the local bytes, size, 0); xml_push_fastbuf(&ctx, fastbuf); ctx.pull = XML_PULL_CHARS | XML_PULL_STAG | XML_PULL_ETAG | XML_PULL_COMMENT | XML_PULL_PI; xml_next(&ctx) until 0 (XML_STATE_STAG: ctx.node ns/name and XML_ATTR_FOR_EACH ns/name/val, xml_ns_by_id; XML_STATE_CHARS: ctx.node text/len; XML_STATE_ETAG/COMMENT/PI); ctx.err_code; xml_cleanup(&ctx)
coverage: LLVM source coverage of LibUCW 6.5's ucw-xml sources (parse.c, ns.c, source.c, dtd.c, common.c), built static with libucw's own configure from the upstream release tarball; libucw and libucw-charset are linked and instrumented but not counted
coverage_limit: Two valid UTF-8 XML 1.0 controls without DOCTYPE establish ucw-xml's namespace-resolved elements, attributes, declarations and character data for them only; DTDs (XML_PARSE_DTD off), external entities, other encodings, XML 1.1 and well-formedness rejection are not established. The expected outputs come from controls/xml/check_controls.py (pyexpat), a different family.
namespace_semantics: ucw-xml resolves namespaces itself once xml_ns_enable() is called (xml.h, 'Namespaces'): every element and attribute carries a namespace ID (xml_ns_by_id gives the URI; 0 = no namespace) and its local name; unprefixed attributes get no namespace. Namespace declarations stay in the element's attribute list: xmlns:p in the xmlns namespace (XML_NS_XMLNS) and the default xmlns with no namespace. The harness counts those as declarations (their non-empty values are the bound URIs) and does not report them as attributes.
